timeline.summary: Maruti Suzuki updated that company arguments before the CCI concluded, with the next hearing scheduled for May 11, 2026.
Maruti Suzuki reported standalone FY26 revenue of ₹183,266.1 Cr and PAT of ₹14,445.4 Cr, recommending a dividend of ₹140 per share.
Maruti Suzuki reported its highest-ever monthly sales of 239,646 units in April 2026.
Maruti Suzuki reported in total production to 209,565 units for April 2026.
Maruti Suzuki filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 4, 2026.
Maruti Suzuki updated that the CCI matter was adjourned to May 25, 2026 for arguments.
On May 18, 2026, Maruti Suzuki commenced commercial production at its second plant in Kharkhoda, expanding total capacity to 2.65 million units.
Maruti Suzuki announced a price increase of up to ₹30,000 across its model portfolio effective June 2026 due to rising input costs.
Maruti Suzuki announced a recall of 26 Super Carry vehicles on May 22, 2026, due to a possible defect in the front driver seat adjuster assembly.
Maruti Suzuki updated that the CCI matter was further adjourned to May 27, 2026 for arguments.
On June 1, 2026; Maruti Suzuki reported total sales of 242,688 units for May 2026
Maruti Suzuki reported total production of 230,041 units for May 2026
Maruti Suzuki launched India's first flex-fuel car, a Wagon R compatible with E20 to E100 ethanol blends, on June 4, 2026.
Maruti Suzuki received a favourable ITAT order yielding a positive tax impact of ~₹1,300 Cr and reducing contingent liabilities by ~₹6,300 Cr.
Maruti Suzuki India Limited launched the VICTORIS AURUM Edition Strong Hybrid on 24 October 2026 with a kit price of INR 22,990.
